name: rules.forecast

list.description: List cash forecast rule configurations for an explicit institution.

parameters.name: inst-id
parameters.description: Explicit native institution identifier; no business default.

summary: Cash forecast rule configurations by explicit institution.
purpose: Inspect existing bank cash forecast configuration without executing a forecast or changing rules.

fields.name: ruleId
fields.meaning: Native rule identity; never replaced by an ordinal or hash.

fields.name: instId
fields.meaning: Native institution scope of the rule.

identity_description: Native ruleId identifies each forecast rule.
limitations: Fixed tenant GUAPW3SG; instId is a singleton containing the explicit inst-id. No entity expansion or user filter.
Native rowStart pagination uses pageSize=1000; result.count is the reported total.
List configuration only; no getter or forecast execution.
Current production qualification is tracked separately in issue #257.
Explicit institution parameterization still requires current production qualification; historical reference evidence does not establish access to other institutions.
